system.description:
You have stolen information from the Hidden Mist elite on utilizing extreme environments to supplement conserving chakra.

Genwa Jutsu you cast have their cost reduced by 1, if you are within the area of effect of; or have been affected by; a jutsu with the lightning release keyword. This cost reduction becomes 2 if you are within 30 feet of a Shocked, Signal Boosted or Firewalled creature.

Once per turn, while you are obscured by the effect of a jutsu you or an allied creature cast, if you move into a space that is not obscured by the jutsu’s effect, you can spend a bonus action to extend it, having the new replicated effect center on you, until the beginning of your next turn.

Jutsu you cast that creates structures or obscurement causes you to be treated as if you are heavily obscured to special senses that rely on sight until the beginning of your next turn.
